blocks.text: Fashion, sisterhood, and the beauty of resilience was brought into the spotlight at the Miss Asia Pacific International 2026 Gala Night for a Cause. Bringing together international beauty queen candidates, Cebuano designers, organizers, and partners, the night showcased the withstanding advocacy of the organization, supporting neurodivergent individuals and children with disabilities in Cebu. Held at the Waterfront Cebu City Hotel & Casino on October 7, the gala brought together international beauty queens, designers, organizers and partners for a night celebrating Filipino creativity, sisterhood and resilience, while raising support for Cebu’s neurodivergent individuals and children with disabilities.
